meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 分析当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR：分类后逐项启动后台任务，生成带证据链接（GitHub permalink）的报告到 /tmp/{日期时间}。只读，绝不在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等触发词时触发。

say.note: 开始分析当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR。
只分析未关闭的 issue，跳过 PR。
只分析未关闭的 PR，跳过 issue。

howto.what_en: Reads every open issue and PR, classifies each, spawns a background quick task per item, and writes permalink-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Read-only: no GitHub comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc.

say_en.note: Starts analysis of all open issues and PRs in the repo.
Analyzes only open issues, skipping PRs.
Analyzes only open PRs, skipping issues.
